preprocessing_verify.reason: No processed tensors; raw kaggle_asl_signs missing on VM

message: Checked out bbd26a7 (NaN preprocess fix). This VM has no KAGGLE_API_TOKEN, no ~/.kaggle/access_token, and no raw asl-signs parquets under /workspace/data/raw/kaggle_asl_signs. A prior agent run downloaded ~94k parquets on a different ephemeral pod; data is not in git. Add KAGGLE_API_TOKEN to the Cloud Agent environment (or mount/persist raw data), re-run scripts/run_data_acquisition.py, then repeat preprocessing → verify → 8-epoch train → ONNX export.
